tickets.body:
Problem: The footer mostly repeats static information. Build activity and faults require a large Jobs & diagnostics pane.

User result: Read useful build, problem, and runtime/connection status in a compact VS Code-style footer. Open the relevant details by clicking or using the keyboard.

Acceptance:
- Replace the static footer content with current build activity, problem counts, and useful runtime/connection health from existing authoritative state.
- Keep idle status concise. Do not invent progress percentages or report stale failures as current.
- Make each actionable status item open or focus its corresponding detail view. Reopen a closed detail pane when needed.
- Keep errors discoverable even while the detail pane is closed. Do not depend on color alone; provide accessible labels and keyboard access.
- Keep footer height and layout stable across idle, building, success, failure, and disconnected states. Status updates must not reflow Preview.
- Demonstrate a successful build, failed build, and connection/runtime failure in Studio, including keyboard navigation to details.

Why now: The user reports wasted workspace space during normal creative use. Existing renderer state already supplies jobs, runtime faults, and connection state; connect these to the footer before adding another status system.
